title: Note
description: Personal note or memo with title, content, author, color coding, tags, pin/archive status, and timestamps. Used for note-taking applications, personal organizers, and knowledge management systems.

author_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user who created the note

author.description: Full name of the note author

color.description: Color code or name for visual organization

tags.description: Array of tags for categorization and search

pinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the top of the list

archived.description: Whether the note is archived and hidden from the main view

created_at.description: Timestamp when the note was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the note was last modified
